# Colecto v0.2.0

A security, reliability and release-pipeline update on top of the first alpha.

## Mail

- HTML mail now appears as soon as its body arrives. Before, one slow or dead remote
  image server (often a hidden tracking pixel) could keep the whole message hidden.
- Links and buttons in HTML mail work in the desktop app: `http`, `https` and `mailto`
  links open in your system browser, and everything else is refused.
- Replies and forwards keep the quoted text within the 100,000-byte body limit, leaving
  room for what you write.

## Safer sending and automation

- A send approval opens the exact request in Settings → Send approvals. Only the review
  card, which shows the recipients and body, offers approval; you can still reject from
  the notification.
- The composer counts attachments (at most 20 files and 25 MB) as soon as you select
  them, waits for every file to be read, and blocks sending if a read failed.
- Automation permissions are enforced more strictly, and mail from untrusted senders is
  bounded: hostile MIME structures are rejected before they are parsed.
- Locking the vault or disconnecting an account no longer waits (up to ten minutes) for
  an open IMAP IDLE or JMAP push connection to end.

## Development and releases

- `just install desktop` copies the app into `~/.local/bin` (replacing it atomically),
  so `cargo clean` or other builds no longer change the installed app; `just cleanup
  desktop` removes it.
- Release builds no longer use thin LTO: rebuilding the app after a source change drops
  from 700 s to 255 s, with a slightly smaller binary. See
  [development](https://github.com/hexvale-labs/colecto/blob/v0.2.0/docs/development.md).
- 32-bit Android builds are dropped; 32-bit platforms are not planned.

## Downloads and limits

Downloads are the same as in v0.1.0 (Linux `.deb`, `.rpm`, `.AppImage`; Windows `.exe`
and `.msi`; Android `.apk`) and are still not code-signed; see
[installing](https://github.com/hexvale-labs/colecto/blob/v0.2.0/docs/install.md). The
[known limits](https://github.com/hexvale-labs/colecto/blob/v0.2.0/docs/roadmap.md) of
v0.1.0 still apply, and storage formats may change between alpha versions.
